title: Counting Back From the Tail
statement:
A linked list is stored in `n` numbered nodes. Node `i` holds the value `v_i` and points to node `nxt_i` (`0` means there is no next node). The list starts at node `head` and passes through all `n` nodes exactly once.

You get `q` queries, each a number `k`. The answer to a query is the value of the `k`-th node counted from the end of the list (`k = 1` is the last node). Print the sum of all the answers.

## Input
The first line contains `n`, `head` and `q`. The second line contains `v_1 ... v_n`. The third line contains `nxt_1 ... nxt_n`. Then `q` lines follow, each with one number `k`.

## Output
Print the sum of the answers.

## Constraints
- `1 <= n <= 10000`
- `1 <= q <= 8000`
- `0 <= v_i <= 10^6`
- `1 <= k <= n`
